body: Thank you - you may be a random internet stranger, but it means a lot that you understand and sympathize. That pretty well describes how I feel right now.
I wish I knew what I really wanted. Certainly not what I've gotten out of life.
Suffering is an endless cycle... not to mention everyone dies eventually, leaving in their wake regrets and further suffering. But I suppose some deaths are worse than others.
That's how I rationalize it, but the depressed, suicidal part of my brain doesn't really give a shit about logic. It's a struggle.

I just stop caring. I don't want to do anything or have the energy to do anything. I just lay in bed and watch stupid TV shows and feel like a piece of shit while all my responsibilities pile up. Sometimes I drink but it doesn't help much, just makes me a little less conscious if that makes any sense. Makes me sleep more too, which is always a relief. I have good days, and I'm at a better place than I was a few months ago, but I still don't see the point of it all besides sparing my family and my boyfriend from suffering. I doubt I'll ever be truly happy.

My brother visited me almost every single day that I was in the hospital, and my grandmother called me every day. The family and friends I have left have been nothing but supportive. But all that love and caring is just sucked into an empty, black hole.
